predecessor_plan.revision_reason: The v3 exact-scope audit proved additional live Step09 consumers: CORE session logs, LLM execution observations and prompt receipts, worker execution labels, the CORE actor verifier, and the CORE-to-RenCrow_LLM Gateway request-correlation contract. v4 adds those owners and gives active historical observation logs an explicit migrate-or-rotate treatment. It does not remove or weaken any v3 safety, security, authentication, policy, migration, or runtime check.

input.root_task_rule: one accepted Turn creates one durable root Task whose TaskID is the already assigned RootTaskID; no second top-level TaskID or legacy JobID is generated
input.child_task_rule: delegation of executable work from Mio to another actual CORE Agent creates one durable child Task with ParentTaskID equal to RootTaskID; Coder model provider controller and worker mechanism never become the assignee actor
input.event_rule: routing.decision is attached to the root Task; agent.assignment is attached to the selected execution Task and causally references the effective routing Event; Task records retain both EventIDs
input.event_sequence_owner: canonical Event Store assigns a positive monotonic EventSeq before monitor and SSE projection and preserves it across restart
input.historical_event_mapping_rule: for each legacy payload pair of canonical envelope TraceID and non-empty job_id, reuse the conversation receipt root_task_id when that trace has one unambiguous root; otherwise derive a deterministic TaskID from the exact trace_id plus legacy job_id; never infer across traces
input.historical_execution_report_mapping_rule: reuse the unique Event migration TaskID for the exact legacy job_id; block if one legacy job_id maps to multiple TaskIDs; when no Event mapping exists derive a deterministic TaskID from the exact namespace execution_report plus legacy job_id; reject duplicate report job IDs and preserve source row order and every non-identity field
input.historical_resilience_mapping_rule: for every incident with a non-empty repair_job_id, require one exact matching legacy execution report row and reuse that row's migrated TaskID as repair_task_id; block missing or ambiguous correlation, preserve all non-identity incident fields and every other regular file byte-for-byte, and reject symlinks or unsupported filesystem entries
input.historical_session_log_mapping_rule: rebuild the complete session-log root into a fresh directory; for each assistant row with job_id, reuse the unique Event migration TaskID for the exact canonical envelope trace_id plus legacy job_id when available, otherwise derive a deterministic TaskID from the exact namespace session_log plus relative path plus legacy job_id; preserve row order, every non-identity field, unrelated regular files, and permissions; reject duplicate JSON fields, symlinks, nested unsupported entries, malformed canonical identities, and source drift
input.historical_prompt_receipt_mapping_rule: rebuild the complete prompt receipt JSONL into a fresh file; for each row with job_id, reuse the unique Event migration TaskID for the exact canonical envelope trace_id plus legacy job_id when available, otherwise derive a deterministic TaskID from the exact namespace prompt_receipt plus legacy job_id; preserve row order and every non-identity field including RequestID without deriving or rewriting it from TaskID; reject duplicate JSON fields, malformed identity, and source drift
input.llm_prompt_debug_rotation_rule: the 1.337GB prompt-debug stream is write-only diagnostic payload history, not canonical state and not rewritten over USB2; after both CORE and Gateway writers stop, atomically rename the exact active file to a timestamped owner-only legacy archive, record its size and SHA256 in the cutover receipt, start a fresh canonical task_id stream, and never expose the archived job_id file as the active path
